tweaks.name: OPTIMAL POWER PLAN
tweaks.description: Creates and activates a custom maximum-performance desktop power plan derived from Ultimate Performance.
tweaks.impact: Prioritizes sustained processor performance and disables automatic sleep while plugged in.
tweaks.tradeoff: Increases energy use, heat, fan noise, and component idle power. Intended only for plugged-in desktop gaming systems.

apply.name: OPTIMAL POWER PLAN
apply.description: Maximum performance profile managed by Optimal

tweaks.name: Install Brave
tweaks.description: Installs the Brave privacy-focused Chromium browser through WinGet.
tweaks.impact: Adds an ad-blocking browser with privacy protections enabled by default.
tweaks.tradeoff: Installs third-party software subject to Brave's license and update service.

tweaks.name: Install Firefox
tweaks.impact: Adds an independently developed browser with extensive privacy controls.
tweaks.tradeoff: Installs third-party software subject to Mozilla's license and update service.

tweaks.name: Install LibreWolf
tweaks.description: Installs LibreWolf, a privacy-hardened Firefox derivative, through WinGet.
tweaks.impact: Adds a browser configured to minimize tracking and telemetry.
tweaks.tradeoff: Aggressive privacy defaults can break DRM, login persistence, or site compatibility.

tweaks.name: Install Microsoft PowerToys
tweaks.description: Installs Microsoft's advanced Windows utilities through WinGet.
tweaks.impact: Adds tools such as FancyZones, PowerRename, and Keyboard Manager.

tweaks.name: Install Everything Search
tweaks.description: Installs the lightweight Everything filename search utility through WinGet.
tweaks.impact: Provides near-instant indexed filename search on NTFS volumes.

tweaks.name: Install LatencyMon
tweaks.description: Installs LatencyMon for measuring DPC/ISR latency and identifying problem drivers.
tweaks.impact: Adds diagnosis tooling; it does not apply unverified latency tweaks.
tweaks.tradeoff: Long measurement sessions add small monitoring overhead and results require interpretation.

tweaks.name: Install GPU-Z
tweaks.description: Installs GPU-Z for graphics hardware, sensor, and driver diagnosis.
tweaks.impact: Adds read-only GPU monitoring and validation tools.
tweaks.tradeoff: Sensor polling can add negligible monitoring overhead while open.

tweaks.name: Install NanaZip
tweaks.description: Installs the modern open-source NanaZip archive manager through WinGet.
tweaks.impact: Adds broad archive support with Windows 11 shell integration.
